ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Care for the teeth PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitation/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Foods/Feeding PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Plants ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Animals ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Weather ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
